text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Duramente secured an overwhelming victory 
in the Japanese Derby with a phenomenal 
run, demonstrating beyond a shadow of a 
doubt the true power of the "Nation's 
Strongest" looking toward the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, facing her completely defeated 
and frustrated rivals from the same 
generation, Cheval Grand acutely felt the 
difference in their passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling more frustrated with herself than 
anything for heading into the race 
half-heartedly, Cheval Grand makes her way 
back to the waiting room.
